'''Aethelaine''' is the local lady of [[Jurador]].

== Activities ==
She swears the [[Oaths of Return]] to the [[Seanchan]] so that they will leave Jurador. Her mansion is in the square of her town. That is all that distinguishes it from the salt merchant mansions.{{ref/book|10|29}}
